chats.title: What changed in Windows 11 in the last 3 updates?

turns.question: What changed in Windows 11 in the last 3 updates?
turns.answer:
Based on the recent updates for Windows 11:

- **Taskbar and Start Menu Customization**: The latest update reintroduced Windows 10-style taskbar and Start Menu customization options. This change is expected to roll out in the coming weeks for versions 24H2, 25H2, and 26H1.
  
- **Renaming of Recommendation Area**: The recommendation area has been renamed to "Recent," keeping newly installed apps visible and refining which files appear in that section. This update is also part of the ongoing rollout.

- **KB5089549 Update Issues**: There have been reports of installation issues with KB5089549, a recent update for Windows 11. However, Microsoft has provided a solution by allowing users to download this update via the official Media Creation Tool for USB installs.

These updates are part of the ongoing improvements and changes in Windows 11 as it continues to evolve based on user feedback and technological advancements.

- **KB5089549 Update Details**: This update, released on April 14, 2026, has faced some installation issues but can now be downloaded for USB installs using the official Microsoft Media Creation Tool. (Source: [Neowin](https://www.neowin.net/news/windows-11-kb5089549-can-now-be-downloaded-for-usb-installs-using-official-microsoft-tool/))

For more detailed information, you can refer to the following sources:
- TechPowerUp: [Microsoft Brings Back Windows 10-Style Taskbar and Start Menu Customization in Windows 11](https://www.techpowerup.com/349132/microsoft-brings-back-windows-10-style-taskbar-and-start-menu-customization-in-windows-11/)
- Neowin: [Windows 11 KB5089549 reportedly failing to install, slowing internet down on certain systems](https://www.neowin.net/news/windows-11-kb5089549-reportedly-failing-to-install-slowing-internet-down-on-certain-systems/) and [Windows 11 KB5089549 can now be downloaded for USB installs using official Microsoft tool](https://www.neowin.net/news/windows-11-kb5089549-can-now-be-downloaded-for-usb-installs-using-official-microsoft-tool/)

These sources provide detailed insights into the recent changes and updates in Windows 11.
